attack.note: Betrayer's Thirst turns every basic attack into healing and cooldown reduction, and Sweeping Strike buffs the next autos by 35 percent. Almost all of his value flows through autos, which is why blinds, stuns and fast attack speed enemies wreck him.

poke.note: He has no ranged damage. Dive and Sweeping Strike are gap closers, not poke.

damage.note: Damage is a steady stream of fast basic attacks amplified by Sweeping Strike, Blades of Azzinoth or Fiery Brand (7 percent max health every third attack). Healing from the enemy can slow him but his own life steal and the cooldown loop outlast weak healers; he is notably hard for healers to beat in a duel. Measured hero damage per minute (about 1910) is below the league median, so he is a sustain and macro hero more than a damage leader.

good_into.why: Dive, Sweeping Strike and The Hunt (stun plus near global range) reach any backline hero and Evasion plus Betrayer's Thirst let him stay on them.
The Hunt reaches anywhere and Illidan solo claims camps and ignores core damage with Evasion, which punishes teams that cannot answer a split pusher.
Healers with weak single target heals cannot out heal his life steal, so he wins duels against them.
Unbound, Marked for Death and Evasion let him hit cores and structures while enemies are away, and the Hunt gets him across the map.

bad_into.why: He only deals damage and recovers cooldowns by attacking, so stuns, roots, blinds and silences turn off both his damage and his survival.
Heroes with slows, knockbacks or fast movement deny his autos and Betrayer's Thirst, which breaks the cooldown loop.
Several melee heroes with strong autos burst through Evasion windows; Reflexive Block and Elusive Strike only partly cover this.
He is weak when behind and has no burst damage prevention, so an assassin heavy comp kills him before he can loop.

wants_from_team: An enabler: shields, armor or instant heals (Medivh, Abathur)
Hard CC from a tank so his autos can stay on target
Teammates who do not need peel from him
A lead before he can use Metamorphosis
gives_team: Map pressure and soaking without losing teamfight presence via The Hunt
A chase hero that is nearly impossible to escape
weaknesses: Vulnerable to blinds and crowd control because he relies on basic attacks
Weak when behind and easy to counter pick
Needs an enabler to shine in teamfights
evidence: Betrayer's Thirst: autos heal 30 percent and reduce cooldowns by 1 second
Hunter's Onslaught, Marked for Death, Fiery Brand, Blades of Azzinoth, Nowhere to Hide talents
Icy Veins guide: vulnerable to crowd control, extremely vulnerable to counter picks
Measured: about 1913 hero damage, 5154 siege, 3508 damage taken per minute, win rate 0.500 over 142 games
owner_notes: A dive melee assassin with decent sustain who dives backlines hard but is weak to CC. A lane bully against many heroes with a high skill ceiling.

lens_notes.damage_delivery: Betrayer's Thirst and Sweeping Strike run through basic attacks, so a blind or stun removes both damage and cooldown reduction.
lens_notes.frontline_style: Icy Veins calls him an offlaner and Hunter reads him as a dive melee assassin. Measured damage taken (about 3500 per minute) fits a bruiser dive role, not a tank.
lens_notes.lane_role: Icy Veins: weak in lane, claims camps painlessly. The Hunt turns him into a split pusher, so this is a close call with split_pusher.
lens_notes.durability_source: Betrayer's Thirst heals, Evasion negates basic attacks, Metamorphosis gives a one second immaterial window and extra health.
lens_notes.escape: Dive, Sweeping Strike, Evasion, Metamorphosis and Bolt of the Storm. Icy Veins: nearly impossible to escape from.
lens_notes.utility_tool: The Hunt is near global, unlimited with Nowhere to Hide which also reveals heroes under 25 percent health.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Only The Hunt stuns, for 1 second, on a 100 second cooldown.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Dive and Sweeping Strike move him through but need the cast to be allowed. Demonic Form halves stun, root and slow duration at level 20 only.
lens_notes.objective_role: Measured siege (about 5150 per minute) is far above median. Evasion lets him ignore core damage.
lens_notes.power_curve: Universal build is weak late, spike at level 10 with the heroic. Split build is a late scaler through Unending Hatred and Unbound.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Universal build takes The Hunt. Metamorphosis is the teamfight alternative with Demonic Form.
lens_notes.team_needs: Icy Veins: needs enablers such as Medivh or Abathur (shield, armor, instant heal). Hunter: weak to CC, so tank CC that keeps his autos on target matters.
lens_notes.vulnerable_to: Blinds, attack speed reduction and anything stopping his basic attacks. Extremely vulnerable to counter picks per Icy Veins.

lens_gaps: No value for blind or basic attack denial on vulnerable_to (it is his main counter).
No lens for enabler dependence (needs shields or armor from Medivh or Abathur), team_needs only has healer.
No lens for dependence on a basic attack cooldown loop (Betrayer's Thirst).
